entries.zh: 那时，当时；（y do entonces）就在那时、到那时候
entries.en: then; at that time; (y do entonces) and even then
entries.notes: H 栏『卒』与 M/R 音写 chūn 不叶，疑为「陣」类字；义据 L 栏 entonces 定。

entries.en: then; at that time
then; at that time; season, time of year
entries.notes: M 栏作 hōusy chiĕ（疑「許時節」），R 栏只对「時節」二字；主义仍从 L 栏 entonces。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕；依 L 栏 entonces，姑释「那时，那时候」
entries.en: [text defective, gloss uncertain] then; at that time
entries.notes: H、R 两栏空缺，仅 L『entronces』（=entonces）与 M『hú sȳ』（疑即許時，另有 fiu 之疑）可参，按残缺处理。

entries.en: entrails, intestines; (fig.) heart, innermost feelings
bosom; innermost feelings; heart

entries.zh: 心肝；内心，心肠；心爱之人
entries.en: heart and liver; the innermost heart; a darling
entries.notes: L 栏『en franas』当为 entrañas 之讹；H/M/R 三栏一致作 心肝（sim-koaⁿ）。

entries.en: to enter; to go in
entries.notes: L 栏『Entriar-』带连字符，为词干形式（当是 entrar）；M 栏后续『laj bahal』不明。

entries.en: to plunge in; to throw oneself into the water
entries.notes: L 栏『utalagua』残乱，疑为『en el agua』；H/R/M 均对 投（tâu）。

entries.en: to leak in; (of water) to enter through a ship's side
entries.notes: L『entravagra』疑为『entra el agua』之讹；H 栏『湏/涵』与 M hām、R hān 相应，取「涵」（浸、渗）义。

entries.en: to advance; to go in first, ahead
to come in; to enter
entries.notes: H 栏『耒』为「來」之讹（M、R 均作 lāy = lâi），故为入來（ji̍p-lâi）。

entries.en: to go inside; to enter within
entries.notes: M 栏末衍西班牙语『dentro』，当为抄/刻误。

entries.en: to shoot into; to pierce in
entries.notes: L 栏『entray.』当为 entrar 之残写；义据 H『射入』与 R ſiē xīp。

entries.en: to go into church; to attend the (Catholic) service
to burst in; to enter rashly and unannounced (de rondón)
entries.notes: H 栏『妥』疑为「妄」之讹（R vāng、M bōrj 对 wàng/bōng）；L『de rondon』即 de rondón。

entries.zh: （把款项）一并算进账里，翻查账目入账
entries.en: to enter into the account; to reckon in
entries.notes: M/R 音写残乱（R『gira』未详）；H 首字『甲』疑为「佮/合」（kap，与、同）。

entries.zh: 记入账目，上账（与他人一并入账）
entries.en: to enter into the account (along with the others); to charge to the account

entries.zh: 夺取，强行取走；侵占他人土地
entries.en: to seize and carry off; to take (another's land) by force
entries.notes: M/R 音写与 H 栏『奪出去』不叶，义据 L 栏『入他人之地而取之』立。

entries.zh: 进入敌国而不与之交战、不待征服（悄然深入）
entries.en: to enter an enemy realm without fighting or subduing it; to slip in unopposed
entries.notes: H 栏『失幾』与 M/R fit qŭy/gŭi 对音不明，仅据 L 栏立义，未能定夺。

entries.en: (of a ship) to take in water; water to enter the ship
entries.notes: H 栏『投宿』与 L 栏『船进水』不合，M zôa 疑为 chúi（水）之讹；仅据 L 栏立义。
